verdict.rationale: Asaas is a payments and banking SaaS that holds customer financial data, so a policy or control against using that data for AI training is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or any related privacy control. The MCP server and llms.txt items concern AI access to public documentation, not protection of user data from training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
